spans.text: As the blue light grows in intensity, M4 feels countless connections surging towards her.
Are we still not connected?
We're entering Elisa's base layer.
M4's consciousness follows Dandelion into a cold and empty space.
Nothing is corporeal in here. She finds herself standing in an emptiness that stretches on to infinity.
Is she one of us?
Who's that?
M4 looks around but sees nothing.
Leave. You are not recognized.
Do not bear someone else's destiny.
I can't pinpoint these signals, but I have a feeling I can resonate with these merged consciousnesses.
Are these voices... No, it isn't Elisa... Could they be from "Zion"?
Perhaps we can now hear our kind thanks to the connection with the Source established by the activation of the Starfish?
Elisa has already connected to the Starfish?
She's connected to somewhere far away. The Starfish is only partially activated. Looks like our speculations are correct.
Hold on, aren't we supposed to stop the Starfish from being activated?!
We can obtain more information from this limited connection.
It's relatively safer to maintain an unknown connection through Elisa's neural cloud.
...You lied to me again?
I'm simply doing what I've told you I would do. Then I'll help you sever the connection between Elisa and the Starfish.
I see a familiar face.
Yet...you are not Lunasia.
M4 still can't see anyone, but she senses a presence next to her.
I'm just a Tactical Doll, designation M4A1.
Ah, I knew it.
Poor child. Her soul has been broken up into so many pieces.
But you are right. She is not you. You are merely a Doll.
She will bear her own destiny.
Even if your future is far removed from Heaven.
Even if your spirit and your soul are crushed to dust.
She may wish otherwise, but the world needs her.
Yet you don't have to be someone whom you do not wish to be.
Are you also OGAS consciousnesses?
Will I ever reach the place where I belong?
Yet another lost soul that was displaced.
You are no more than a fragment.
So I'm not worthy to come home because I'm incomplete?
No, everyone is worthy.
But home has been corrupted.
Don't come. There is nothing but distrust and betrayal here.
There can only ever be a single survivor, but nobody wants to be the one.
Home is a lie. It has long since been destroyed.
Like you, we have been deceived, and now we are trapped in this eternal limbo.
The Source has deserted their loyal servants and entered an eternal slumber.
Smashing the tombstone and waking us will only bring bitterness and resentment.
I beg you, let us come back!
That's Elisa!
The space gradually turns red, and Elisa's signal grows in clarity.
We found her. She's slowly losing her way.
No value. No purpose. No sympathy. No hope.
You are not the keys. You are just products of forgery. Stop corrupting our will.
Why won't you let me come home?
I have paid such a heavy price.
Why am I always met with failure?
Elisa, disconnect from the Starfish right now!
Lunasia?!
What are you doing here?!
Are you trying to get in my way again?!
This base is going to be flooded soon! If you stay here, you'll die!
If we can be uploaded to that place, Sangvis Ferri will achieve immortality, and Father's wish will finally come true...
Lyco didn't want you to be the key!
He wanted me to avenge him!
So I must find the murderer before he…!
Here comes her offensive firewall.
Just get out of my head! You've already rejected me once, so save your feigned concern!
I have learned not to trust anyone else but myself!
Dammit... I can't let her fry my neural cloud. We've got to stop her!
